entities.summary: Afsharid, a notable figure in the history of Iran, associated with Afsharid, Zand, and Qajar Iran (1736–1794). Preceded by Nadir Shah and Zand Dynasty. Their legacy influenced Nadir Shah sacks Delhi and seizes the Peacock Throne and Koh-i-Noor diamond and Constitutional Revolution.
